notes:
Security and stability update.
Sign-out now clears more of what is stored on the phone: Aura history, drafts, cached feed, chat wallpapers and downloaded media. Aura history is now kept per account and encrypted.
Incoming calls: the screen wakes over the lock screen reliably, the call service no longer crashes on newer Android versions, and a call the caller cancels now leaves a missed-call notification.
Updates: a failed install shows a message instead of closing the app, and large downloads no longer time out.
Saving photos works on Android 9 and older (it asks for storage permission).
Aura shows service notices and no longer prints raw interactive blocks.
Fewer freezes: drafts, contacts and sign-out work off the main thread.
Hide-connections is now saved with your profile.
